name: signup-03
title: Signup 03
description: A card on a quiet desk with paper clips and push-pins lying about. Password and confirmation side by side, and a tally under them that counts how strong the password is. Terms line under the card.
docs:
Installed the "Signup 03" block into your components directory under blocks/signup-03/.
Import it: import Signup03Page from "<your components alias>/blocks/signup-03/page"
Needs vee-validate@^5, vee-validate@^7, zod@^4: the CLI installs them (a project on an older major is upgraded).
